evd_title: Fine-tuned Llama 2 improved from F1=0.63 (64% accuracy) to F1=0.84 (83% accuracy) on CONSORT guideline questions
finding: Fine-tuned Llama 2 improved from F1=0.63 (64% accuracy) to F1=0.84 (83% accuracy) on CONSORT guideline questions
P: TEST split (20%) of 113 sports-medicine RCT reports (Schulz et al. 2020 dataset), 8 CONSORT text items
I: Llama 2 70B (TogetherAI), zero-shot base vs fine-tuned on GPT-4-correct TRAIN labels; paper split into sections
C: Base Llama 2 70B (pre-fine-tuning); Schulz et al. labels as ground truth; ref GPT-4 Turbo F1 0.89
S: Within-model before/after comparison on held-out test split
T: Papers published 2020; Llama 2 version on TogetherAI mid-2024; paper 2025
